title: Listing Highlight: 75' Azimut Yachts 2009 | TABATA
description: Explore the 2009 Azimut Yachts 105-foot motor yacht—a refined charter and sales opportunity combining Italian craftsmanship with modern luxury amenities.
html:
Discover A Sophisticated Italian-Built Vessel Perfect For 60+ Discerning Yacht Enthusiasts

The 2009 Azimut Yachts represents the pinnacle of Italian yacht design and engineering, offering a compelling blend of elegance, performance, and comfort. This 75-foot motor yacht stands as an ideal choice for experienced yacht enthusiasts aged 60 and above who seek both the thrill of ownership and the flexibility of charter opportunities. Built to exacting standards by Azimut Yachts, one of the world's most respected shipyards, this vessel delivers the sophistication and reliability that discerning captains and owners have come to expect.

With its sleek exterior profile and commanding presence on the water, the 2009 Azimut Yachts showcases the brand's signature design language. The yacht's hull form has been optimized for both seaworthiness and fuel efficiency, allowing for extended cruising range without sacrificing performance. The spacious flybridge offers panoramic views and serves as an ideal gathering space for entertaining guests or simply enjoying the open water. Below deck, the main salon features generous proportions, premium furnishings, and abundant natural light through large windows that frame the surrounding seascape.

The accommodations aboard this Azimut reflect a commitment to comfort and luxury. Multiple staterooms provide private retreats for family and guests, each appointed with quality finishes and modern conveniences. The galley is fully equipped to support extended voyages, while the crew quarters ensure that professional staff can operate the vessel efficiently. The master suite commands the most desirable location aboard, offering a private sanctuary with en-suite facilities and direct access to the upper deck.

Propulsion and handling are hallmarks of Azimut's engineering excellence. This 2009 model is powered by twin diesel engines that deliver reliable performance across a range of sea conditions. The yacht's stabilization systems minimize rolling motion, enhancing comfort for all aboard. Advanced navigation and communication systems keep the vessel connected and safe, while the integrated bridge design allows the captain full command and visibility.

The 2009 Azimut Yachts is ideally suited for both charter operations and private ownership. For those seeking to generate revenue, the vessel's proven track record in the charter market demonstrates strong demand among luxury travelers. For owner-operators, the yacht offers the freedom to explore distant cruising grounds with confidence and style. The combination of Italian heritage, modern systems, and timeless design ensures that this vessel will remain a valued asset for years to come.

Key specifications include a length of 75 feet, accommodating up to 10 guests across multiple staterooms, with professional crew quarters. The yacht's cruising speed and range make it suitable for both coastal exploration and offshore passages. Built in 2009, this vessel represents a sweet spot in the market—newer than 2000 as required, with proven systems and a well-documented service history.
